spec.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place,
  (array_agg(q.quarter_label ORDER BY q.quarter_start))[1] AS first_q,
  (array_agg(q.quarter_label ORDER BY q.quarter_start DESC))[1] AS last_q
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT quarter_start, quarter_label FROM report_fudging_share('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) WHERE is_complete) q
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT q.*, s.checked_n, s.flagged_n, s.flagged_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'min_readings') AS min_readings, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'warn_ratio') AS warn_ratio, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'flag_ratio') AS flag_ratio
FROM report_fudging_quarterly('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) q
JOIN report_fudging_share('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s ON s.quarter_start = q.quarter_start
WHERE q.is_selected AND q.is_complete
  AND q.quarter_start = (SELECT max(quarter_start) FROM report_fudging_share('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) WHERE is_complete)
  AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT q.org_unit_id, q.org_unit_name, q.level, q.is_selected, q.quarter_start, q.quarter_label, q.too_few, q.flag,
  q.n_130_139, q.n_140_149, q.ratio, q.band,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'min_readings') AS min_readings, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'warn_ratio') AS warn_ratio, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'flag_ratio') AS flag_ratio
FROM report_fudging_quarterly('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) q
WHERE q.is_complete AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
ORDER BY q.quarter_start

spec.description: Ratio is readings of 130–139 divided by readings of 140–149, every visit in the quarter. Green is under 1.8, yellow from 1.8, red from 2.0. Hover a ratio to see its counts. Click a facility to see it alone.
spec.title: Readings of 130–139 and 140–149, by facility and quarter

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.quarter_start, s.quarter_label, s.checked_n, s.flagged_n, s.flagged_pct
FROM report_fudging_share('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
WHERE s.is_complete AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
ORDER BY s.quarter_start

spec.description: Of the facilities with enough readings, the share whose ratio is 2.0 or more in each completed quarter.
spec.title: % of facilities with a ratio of 2.0 or more, by quarter
